title: Archiver
description: Archiver - donate storage on purpose: hold other people's data up to a quota you choose, and see exactly what is on your disk.
summary: Pointers are worthless if every copy they point at is asleep or gone, so somebody has to hold other people's bytes. This is that offer, made deliberately: a quota you set (zero by default, because silence is not consent), what it accepts (the authors you follow, and the peers with nowhere else to go — LAN, Bluetooth, LoRa), and a list of everything being held for others with a Drop on every row. A quota is a ceiling, not a target: full is full, and nothing of yours is ever evicted to make room.
